name: doomolingo
title: DOOMOLINGO
blurb: a doomlike vocabulary shooter — a demon shouts an english word, you gun down the right translation in spanish, french, german, or latin before the timer (and your health bar) hits zero. @kumavis.me wanted the language app that's not for babies, riffing on a bit from @weeder.bsky.social quoting @jlp.systems.
